dark-plate-paper.purpose: Cards, fields, table rows, navigation and dialogs

dark-well.purpose: Inset summaries, active navigation and hover fills

dark-ink.purpose: Primary text, headings and ink buttons

dark-oxide.purpose: Primary actions, slide references, focus and selection

status-green-wash.purpose: Completed stamp and confirmation hover fill

dark-status-green-wash.purpose: Completed stamp and confirmation hover fill

dark-status-red.purpose: Needs Review, errors and destructive actions

status-red-wash.purpose: Review hatch and caution hover fill

dark-status-red-wash.purpose: Review hatch and caution hover fill

navigation-surface.purpose: Desktop rail, mobile header and drawer

dark-navigation-surface.purpose: Desktop rail, mobile header and drawer

hover-surface.purpose: Hover fill for navigation, appearance, secondary and ghost controls

dark-hover-surface.purpose: Hover fill for navigation, appearance, secondary and ghost controls

selected-control.purpose: Selected Dashboard period, Reports status and Pollen Map visibility controls

dark-selected-control.purpose: Selected Dashboard period, Reports status and Pollen Map visibility controls

slideOverlay.purpose: Okabe-Ito without black; per-report abundance order; every box also carries its species code.

catalogSeries.purpose: Chart series; nine hues cycled over 23 taxa; legends always name the taxon.

mapIntensity.purpose: ColorBrewer YlOrBr quantile classes (colour-blind safe, print friendly); zero and unsampled fills are distinct answers.

headline.purpose: Every page h1 in the page header; identifier titles switch to mono.

figure.purpose: Dashboard summary and species grain totals use compact mono readouts.

binomial.purpose: Scientific names, always serif italic, followed by the mono species code.

caption.purpose: Sentence-case labels for fields and sections.

plate-label.purpose: IBM Plex Mono references for slide and figure numbers (.plate-label).

body.purpose: All UI text; tabular numerals globally.

body-small.purpose: Dense rows, fields, captions of controls.

mono.purpose: IDs, species codes, counts and figures only.

classes.name: caption-label
classes.value: font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-muted);
classes.purpose: Field and section labels inside plates.

classes.name: card-panel
classes.value: border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--card-radius, 1.25rem); background: var(--surface); box-shadow: var(--card-shadow);
classes.purpose: Standalone research work surfaces and metric cards.

classes.name: card-panel-interactive
classes.value: hover border: var(--border-strong); hover shadow: var(--card-shadow-hover);
classes.purpose: Interactive collection-site and species reference cards.

classes.name: card-well
classes.purpose: Secondary summaries inset inside a work card.

classes.name: control-selection
classes.purpose: Subdued selected-control and filled neutral-action boundary.

classes.name: dark-editable-fields
classes.value: :root[data-theme="dark"] enabled neutral-border fields: background-color: var(--field-bg); border-color: var(--field-border); caret-color: var(--accent);
classes.purpose: Distinguishable editable boundaries; excludes invalid/error and disabled states.

shadows.name: card-rest
shadows.purpose: Quiet separation for standalone card panels.

shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.purpose: Subtle emphasis for interactive cards on hover.

shadows.name: card-rest-dark
shadows.purpose: Quiet separation for standalone dark card panels.

shadows.name: card-hover-dark
shadows.purpose: Subtle emphasis for interactive dark cards on hover.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions, drawer fade and count-up.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Hover and colour changes on buttons and nav.

motion.name: duration-slow
motion.purpose: Upper bound; nothing runs longer except the stat count-up (500ms).

motion.name: press-scale
motion.purpose: Active state on buttons and chips.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Rail replaces the mobile bar; page header becomes sticky.

breakpoints.name: xl
breakpoints.purpose: Plate + key split (3fr/2fr); dashboard Recent Collections and Top Pollen Counts sit side by side, with Collection Conditions full width below.

appearance.authority: User-approved established-world extension; adviser/paper reconciliation remains open.
appearance.persistence: Browser-local, separate from authentication and retained across sign-out; same-page events and storage events sync tabs; malformed values use defaults; blocked storage falls back to current-page memory.
appearance.initialPaint: Early root script sets data-theme and data-sidebar before content paints.
appearance.imagery: Microscope pixels and catalog photos are never filtered; only the transparent brand wordmark is inverted in dark mode.

mapBadgeLabels.rule: readableOn uses fill luminance, independently of interface theme.

appearance.nativeControls: color-scheme follows the selected theme; the dark select chevron uses faint ink (#9fadb6). Enabled neutral-border fields use field-bg/field-border and an oxide caret; invalid/error and disabled states retain their own treatment.
appearance.toasts: AppearanceToaster passes the selected theme to Sonner.

darkRefinement.authority: User-requested refinement of the established Laboratory Console; prior appearance defaults and persistence remain unchanged.
darkRefinement.direction: Deeper charcoal page, lifted panels, darker navigation and recessed editable fields. Quiet outlined selected controls replace bright inverse tabs; neutral filled actions have a separate hover surface. Light role aliases preserve incumbent visuals.
darkRefinement.navigationActive: Oxide wash with a 1px inset outline mixed from 38% oxide.

contrastChecks.scope: Measured implemented dark interface pairs; not every image or data colour.
contrastChecks.rounding: Ratios rounded to two decimal places.

sidebar.toggle: Always visible; action aria-label and title, aria-expanded and aria-controls=desktop-sidebar.
sidebar.collapsedLabels: Desktop text/wordmark hide; links, theme, help and account retain accessible names and title hints; active navigation retains aria-current.
sidebar.mobile: 56px header, compact theme button and 17rem labelled drawer (max 85vw), unaffected by stored desktop collapse.

components.name: Accent Button
components.description: The one primary action on a page (Download PDF, Save, Analyze).
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-accent"><svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4"/><polyline points="7 10 12 15 17 10"/><line x1="12" y1="15" x2="12" y2="3"/></svg>Download PDF</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: var(--accent, #8c2f1b); color: var(--accent-fg, #fff); font-family: var(--font-body, 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-accent:hover { background: var(--accent-hover, #742617); } .ds-btn-accent:active { background: var(--accent-active, #5e1f13); transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-accent:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #8c2f1b); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Default for every other action (Mark Completed, Excel).
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: var(--surface, #fafaf7); color: var(--text, #171717); font-family: var(--font-body, 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #d9d8d2); border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 120ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong, #b3b1a8); background: var(--surface-hover, #f1f0eb); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #8c2f1b); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Irreversible actions, confirmed in a dialog.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: var(--danger, #b3261e); color: var(--danger-fg, #fff); font-family: var(--font-body, 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 120ms; } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-destructive:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #8c2f1b); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Consequence Buttons
components.description: Outline buttons whose status hue names the consequence: caution (red) leaves or removes, confirm (green) completes, resume (ochre) returns to a pending item.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-caution">Sign Out</button> <button class="ds-btn-confirm">Mark Completed</button> <button class="ds-btn-resume">Resume Analysis</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-caution,.ds-btn-confirm,.ds-btn-resume { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; background:var(--surface,#fafaf7); font-family:var(--font-body,'IBM Plex Sans',system-ui,sans-serif); font-size:14px; font-weight:500; padding:8px 16px; border-radius:2px; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 120ms, transform 120ms; } .ds-btn-caution { color:var(--danger,#b3261e); border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger, #b3261e) 40%, transparent); } .ds-btn-caution:hover { border-color:var(--danger,#b3261e); background:var(--danger-bg,#b3261e14); } .ds-btn-confirm { color:var(--success,#1f6a3a); border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--success, #1f6a3a) 40%, transparent); } .ds-btn-confirm:hover { border-color:var(--success,#1f6a3a); background:var(--success-bg,#1f6a3a14); } .ds-btn-resume { color:var(--processing,#8a5a00); border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--processing, #8a5a00) 40%, transparent); } .ds-btn-resume:hover { border-color:var(--processing,#8a5a00); background:var(--processing-bg,#8a5a0014); } .ds-btn-caution:active,.ds-btn-confirm:active,.ds-btn-resume:active { transform:scale(0.97); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Enabled editable field: recessed fill and clearer boundary in dark mode; light keeps plate paper and hairline. Error/invalid and disabled fields retain their own states.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; } .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 4px; font-family: var(--font-body, 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--text-muted, #4d4c47); } .ds-input { width: 100%; background: var(--field-bg, #fafaf7); color: var(--text, #171717); font-family: var(--font-body, 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 13px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--field-border, #d9d8d2); border-radius: 2px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-placeholder, #6d6c66); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong, #b3b1a8); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #8c2f1b); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Rail Navigation
components.description: Desktop rail at lg: 240px expanded or 80px icon rail; expand control stays visible, active links retain aria-current and hidden text retains accessible names/title hints. Mobile uses a labelled drawer independently of desktop collapse.
components.html: DashboardReportsPollen Map
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; width: var(--sidebar-width, 240px); padding: 20px; background: var(--surface-nav, #fafaf7); border-right: 1px solid var(--border, #d9d8d2); } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 2px; font-family: var(--font-body, 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-muted, #4d4c47); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--surface-hover, #f1f0eb); color: var(--text, #171717); } .ds-nav-item[aria-current=page] { background: var(--surface-sunken, #f1f0eb); color: var(--text, #171717); } :host-context([data-theme="dark"]) .ds-nav-item[aria-current=page] { background: var(--accent-muted, #e4a0841c); outline: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent,#e4a084) 38%,transparent); outline-offset: -1px; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #8c2f1b); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Status Stamps
components.description: Pending dashed, Completed solid, Needs Review hatched; always worded.
components.html: Pending Completed Needs Review
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; white-space: nowrap; padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid; border-radius: 1px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; font-family: var(--font-body, 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-stamp-pending { border-style: dashed; border-color: var(--processing, #8a5a00); color: var(--processing, #8a5a00); } .ds-stamp-completed { border-color: var(--success, #1f6a3a); background: var(--success-bg, #1f6a3a14); color: var(--success, #1f6a3a); } .ds-stamp-review { border-color: var(--danger, #b3261e); color: var(--danger, #b3261e); background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, var(--danger-bg, #b3261e14) 0 4px, transparent 4px 8px); }

components.name: Species Filter Chip
components.description: Filters a plate's boxes by type: swatch, mono code, faint count.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; } .ds-chip { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #d9d8d2); border-radius: 2px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface, #fafaf7) 50%, transparent); color: var(--text-muted, #4d4c47); font-family: var(--font-body, 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 12.5px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 120ms, color 120ms; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong, #b3b1a8); color: var(--text, #171717); } .ds-chip[aria-pressed=true] { border-color: var(--border-strong, #b3b1a8); background: var(--surface, #fafaf7); color: var(--text, #171717); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #8c2f1b); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-swatch { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 2px; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-code { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace); font-weight: 500; } .ds-count { color: var(--text-faint, #5f5e59); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Specimen Work Card
components.description: Rounded work card with a Plex Sans title, mono slide reference, neutral slide surround and ruled caption strip. The image frame inside stays compact.
components.html:
Specimen Image

Slide 1 of 2
Slide 1 slide-1.png · 15 grains · mostly Axonopus compressus15/15 shown
components.css: .ds-plate { background: var(--surface, #fafaf7); border: 1px solid var(--border, #d9d8d2); border-radius: 20px; box-shadow: var(--card-shadow, 0 1px 2px rgb(23 23 23 / 3%), 0 9px 24px rgb(23 23 23 / 4%)); padding: 20px; max-width: 560px; } .ds-plate-head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 16px; } .ds-plate-title { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-display, 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: var(--text, #171717); } .ds-plate-label { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--accent, #8c2f1b); } .ds-figure { border: 1px solid var(--border, #d9d8d2); border-radius: 2px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-slide { height: 220px; background: var(--viewer-bg, #2a2a28); } .ds-caption { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 8px 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border, #d9d8d2); font-family: var(--font-display, 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 14px; color: var(--text, #171717); } .ds-readout { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace); font-weight: 500; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--text-muted, #4d4c47); white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Key Row
components.description: One detection beside the plate: swatch, serif-italic binomial, mono code and count; selected row in oxide wash.
components.css: .ds-key { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; width: 100%; max-width: 420px; margin-bottom: 6px; padding: 10px 12px; text-align: left; background: var(--surface, #fafaf7); border: 1px solid var(--border, #d9d8d2); border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 120ms, background-color 120ms; } .ds-key:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong, #b3b1a8); } .ds-key[aria-pressed=true] { border-color: var(--accent, #8c2f1b); background: var(--accent-muted, #8c2f1b17); } .ds-key:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #8c2f1b); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-key-swatch { width: 12px; height: 12px; margin-top: 5px; border-radius: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.2); flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-key-name i { font-family: var(--font-taxonomy, 'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif); } .ds-key-name { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; gap: 0 8px; font-family: var(--font-display, 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 15.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text, #171717); } .ds-key-code { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: var(--text-muted, #4d4c47); } .ds-key-count { text-align: right; font-family: var(--font-mono, 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text, #171717); } .ds-key-count small { display: block; font-family: var(--font-body, 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; color: var(--text-muted, #4d4c47); }

components.name: Dashboard Collection Context
components.description: Shared exact-location and 6/12-month controls appear first, defaulting to 6 Months, followed by grains counted, pollen types and average model confidence. The summary spans the available width; analysis status controls remain on Reports. Recent Collections shows up to five finalized records beside Top Pollen Counts; saved Collection Conditions spans the width below. Top counts sum grains across all matching finalized slides and link to supporting reports. Sample contributions remain stamped.

components.name: Species Card
components.description: Allergen Reference grid card using the shared rounded card surface: photo, scientific name, plant names, risk stamp, and a footer with swatch, code and grain count. Opens the full record.
components.css: .ds-species-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;width:180px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--border,#d9d8d2);border-radius:20px;background:var(--surface,#fafaf7);box-shadow:var(--card-shadow,0 1px 2px rgb(23 23 23 / 3%),0 9px 24px rgb(23 23 23 / 4%));text-align:left;cursor:pointer;padding:0} .ds-species-card:hover{border-color:var(--border-strong,#b3b1a8);box-shadow:var(--card-shadow-hover,0 2px 4px rgb(23 23 23 / 4%),0 12px 28px rgb(23 23 23 / 7%))} .ds-species-photo{aspect-ratio:4/3;background:var(--surface-sunken,#f1f0eb);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border,#d9d8d2)} .ds-species-body{display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:10px 12px 12px} .ds-binomial{font-family:var(--font-taxonomy,'Source Serif 4',Georgia,serif);font-style:italic;font-weight:600;font-size:16px;color:var(--text,#171717)} .ds-plant{font-size:13px;color:var(--text-muted,#4d4c47);margin-top:2px} .ds-foot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:12px;padding-top:8px;border-top:1px solid var(--border,#d9d8d2);font-size:12px;font-family:var(--font-mono,monospace)}

components.name: Appearance Controls
components.description: Theme action and desktop rail action remain accessible in the expanded and collapsed shell; browser-local preferences synchronize across tabs. Theme is also available in mobile header, sign-in and Appearance settings.

components.name: Neutral Filled Action
components.description: Filled neutral action retains the light ink-button treatment and uses subdued charcoal with an inset outline in dark mode. Oxide remains reserved for the primary accented action.
components.css: .ds-btn-neutral{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;background:var(--button-neutral,#171717);color:var(--button-neutral-fg,#ecebe6);outline:1px solid var(--selected-border,transparent);outline-offset:-1px;border:0;border-radius:2px;padding:8px 16px;font-family:var(--font-body,"IBM Plex Sans",system-ui,sans-serif);font-size:14px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1),transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)}.ds-btn-neutral:hover{background:var(--button-neutral-hover,color-mix(in srgb,#171717 85%,transparent))}.ds-btn-neutral:active{background:var(--button-neutral,#171717);transform:scale(0.97)}.ds-btn-neutral:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#8c2f1b);outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview:
PolLens is a focused workspace for examining microscope slides and maintaining research records. It should feel precise, legible and calm at a bright lab bench. Short labels and a clear task hierarchy keep attention on the slide, its detections and the collection details. The warm grey page, paper surfaces, hairline rules and oxide action colour remain; species colours stay attached to data.

IBM Plex Sans carries the interface and IBM Plex Mono marks IDs, codes and figures. Source Serif 4 italic distinguishes scientific names from surrounding controls. Work surfaces use generous paper cards with a quiet shadow, while controls, data rows and microscope plates retain compact geometry. Information stays grouped by task. Required sample, status, missing-data and recovery messages remain visible.

Light remains the default for bright bench light. The user-approved appearance extension (2026-10-13) adds a dark version of the same console for lower ambient light and a collapsible desktop navigation rail. Typography, task hierarchy, status patterns and data palettes keep the same roles in both modes.

Do not invent measurements, model performance, calibration marks or instrument readouts. The interface should show only what the image or report supports.
keyCharacteristics: Warm grey page and plate-paper cards by default; dark semantic surfaces on request, with hairline frames and restrained card shadows.
One oxide accent for plate/figure numbers, the primary action and focus.
IBM Plex Sans for the interface; IBM Plex Mono for IDs, codes and figures; Source Serif 4 italic for scientific names.
Short page titles, compact controls and secondary details behind clear disclosures.
Rounded work cards (20px); controls, stamps and embedded data marks keep compact corners (1–3px).
Status stamps that differ by pattern (dashed, solid, hatched) as well as by colour.
Species colours and the map ramp are data, never decoration.

rules.name: The One Oxide Rule
rules.body: Oxide marks a plate or figure number, the page's primary action, an inline text action, a selection, or focus. It does nothing else. It never tints a heading word, an icon or a background for mood.

rules.name: The Data Is Not Decoration Rule
rules.body: Species colours and the map ramp only encode data. They never style chrome, and chrome colours never stand in for a species. Wherever a data colour appears, a code, name or number says the same thing.

rules.name: The Plain Label Rule
rules.body: Labels use sentence case and name the field or value directly. Use oxide only for the primary action, focus and concise slide references.

rules.name: The Mono Means Identifier Rule
rules.body: The mono face is for things you would copy, compare or count: IDs, species codes, counts and figures. It is not for prose, buttons or headings. The PolLens wordmark (mono, uppercase, 0.18em tracking) is an identity asset and sets no precedent.

rules.name: The Quiet Card Rule
rules.body: Use `card-panel` for a standalone work surface, with a 20px radius, hairline frame and restrained shadow. Use `card-well` for a secondary inset summary. Keep controls, rows, species marks and the microscope image frame compact; card styling should clarify hierarchy, not decorate data.

dos: Do keep the light page grey (#ecebe6), plates on plate paper (#fafaf7) and frames at a 1px hairline (#d9d8d2); use the corresponding semantic dark tokens when dark mode is selected.
Do spend the mode's oxide (light #8c2f1b) only on plate/figure numbers, the one primary action, inline text actions, selection and focus.
Do use concise Plex Mono slide references ("Slide 2 of 3") and sentence-case Plex Sans field labels.
Do set scientific names in serif italic, followed by the mono species code.
Do set IDs, species codes, counts and figures in IBM Plex Mono with tabular numerals.
Do give every status a stamp pattern and a word as well as a colour.
Do caption each specimen plate under a hairline rule with file, grain count and dominant species.
Do keep the viewer surround a neutral dark (#2a2a28) so slide colour reads true.
Do default to light for bright bench light and honor the user's saved dark mode and desktop rail preference.
donts: Don't use soft drop shadows, glows or floating rounded cards. Separate with hairlines and wells.
Don't round plates, buttons or fields beyond 3px.
Don't use species colours or the map ramp for chrome, emphasis or mood, and don't let colour be the only carrier of a species, status or class.
Don't colour a headline word, an icon or a background in oxide for emphasis.
Don't set labels as tracked uppercase sans, or put a decorative label line above a heading.
Don't use the mono face for prose, buttons or section headings.
Don't draw scale bars, magnification readouts or calibrated units on slide images. The images carry no calibration.
Don't add icons to stat figures or show placeholder numbers while data is loading.
Don't add a second accent colour or apply theme filters to specimen imagery, species colours or map data fills.
